changes: experiments/pos-instrument-replay/analyze-batch.mjs (new): a PURELY OFFLINE analyzer that reads the four committed evidence streams (batch-ledger.jsonl H1/H4, tamper-verdicts.jsonl H2, resume-reconciliation.json H3) + protocol.json, re-verifies every batch-ledger recordDigest (aborts with a named id on a naively-edited ledger), and adjudicates each hypothesis to a STRICT three-state verdict (pass|fail|inconclusive) validated down to substantive values: H1 requires exactly protocol.N[scale] well-formed (full 10-key goldMetrics + non-empty digests) pairwise-equal records with no undeclared scales; H2 binds each (class,handling) identity to its protocol-expected disposition; H3 validates the substantive kill-trial values (dup/gap/casualtyDisposition + killC.stoppedRecordPreserved); H4 requires finite non-negative elapsed <= cap. It writes report.json + report.md with a reproducible digest = sha256(canonicalJson(report minus digest)), embedding the section-3 claim text only when all-pass. selfcheck-m4.mjs (new): 19 hermetic un-gameable sub-checks A-S. report.json/report.md (new): the campaign's H1-H4 verdict + reproducible digest.

outcomeDiff: No difference. Actual matched the expected PLAN outcome on every field: the four verdicts, overall all-pass, the digest value, determinism (byte-identical regeneration + cross-vendor re-derivation), and the selfcheck A-S result.
limitations: The report asserts fail-closed / all-pass over the TESTED evidence streams and their substantive values against the FROZEN protocol; it is NOT an unconditional impossibility proof and NOT Tier-C adversarial ledger integrity (a signing adversary who recomputes digests is out of scope per plan §3). The claim text is embedded only when all four hypotheses are supported (no-overclaim). none otherwise — fully covered.
pitfalls: The capstone ADJUDICATOR needed the hardest adversarial review of the whole campaign: over 4 review rounds Codex host-2 found real HIGH false-passes the 3 Claude lanes missed in rounds 1-2 (H1 completeness/vacuous, H2 identity + identity->disposition binding, H3 stub + nested-value, H4 non-physical) — a lenient three-state that accepts incomplete/stub/count-only/mislabeled evidence as pass silently defeats the entire campaign. The fix progression was structure->completeness->identity->VALUES: keep hardening until every stream is validated to its substantive values vs the frozen protocol AND Codex says NO REAL FINDINGS + independently re-derives the digest. Keep verification_evidence notes precise. quorum_submit needs a CURRENT review_pass_set for EVERY lane (a lane that filed a finding instead of passing blocks it) — resolve the finding and get a clean pass round first. DEV->REVIEW needs scope_contract_acknowledge for all .lattice/story/actives/<id>/*.json lifecycle metadata (enforce-mode scope gate). milestone_ledger/intent_collision/proofstory are PLAN-frozen (unavailable in DEV). validate hits the 300s idle-watchdog on the ~4-min build/selfcheck: re-run with LATTICE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS bumped + clear the orphan .lattice/locks/validation/<id>.lock.
